hints.title: Top-Down Hierarchy Level
hints.text: Use a recursive CTE starting with the top-level chief executive where manager_id is NULL to establish depth level for each employee.

hints.title: Bottom-Up Subordinate Aggregation
hints.text: Trace all direct and indirect reports using a second recursive CTE to count total managed team size.

hints.title: Budget Rollup and Ordering
hints.text: Sum the salaries of all subordinates and add the manager own salary, ordering by level ascending, budget descending, and name ascending.

hints.title: Reference Implementation
hints.text:
```sql
WITH RECURSIVE EmployeeHierarchy AS (
    SELECT employee_id, employee_name, manager_id, salary, 1 AS level
    FROM Employees
    WHERE manager_id IS NULL
    UNION ALL
    SELECT Employees.employee_id, Employees.employee_name, Employees.manager_id, Employees.salary, EmployeeHierarchy.level + 1
    FROM Employees
    INNER JOIN EmployeeHierarchy ON Employees.manager_id = EmployeeHierarchy.employee_id
),
TeamSizeAndBudget AS (
    WITH RECURSIVE Subordinates AS (
        SELECT manager_id, employee_id, salary
        FROM Employees
        WHERE manager_id IS NOT NULL
        UNION ALL
        SELECT Subordinates.manager_id, Employees.employee_id, Employees.salary
        FROM Employees
        INNER JOIN Subordinates ON Employees.manager_id = Subordinates.employee_id
    )
    SELECT 
        Employees.employee_id, 
        COUNT(DISTINCT Subordinates.employee_id) AS team_size, 
        IFNULL(SUM(Subordinates.salary), 0) + Employees.salary AS total_budget 
    FROM Employees
    LEFT JOIN Subordinates ON Employees.employee_id = Subordinates.manager_id
    GROUP BY Employees.employee_id, Employees.salary
)
SELECT 
    EmployeeHierarchy.employee_id, 
    EmployeeHierarchy.employee_name, 
    EmployeeHierarchy.level, 
    IFNULL(TeamSizeAndBudget.team_size, 0) AS team_size, 
    IFNULL(TeamSizeAndBudget.total_budget, EmployeeHierarchy.salary) AS budget 
FROM EmployeeHierarchy 
LEFT JOIN TeamSizeAndBudget USING (employee_id)
ORDER BY 
    EmployeeHierarchy.level ASC, 
    budget DESC, 
    EmployeeHierarchy.employee_name ASC;
```

complexity.notes: Recursive CTE traverses tree hierarchy to compute levels and subordinate closures.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Self-referencing tree structures of arbitrary depth cannot be resolved with fixed-depth joins.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Recursive CTE maps transitive subordinate relationships before group-by aggregation.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Write recursive Common Table Expressions to calculate tree depth and rollup aggregations.
